body: Special Meeting of the Burbank Glendale Pasadena Regional Housing Trust
agenda_text:
SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA

  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 27, 2023 - 4:30 P.M.

  MEETING WILL BE HELD IN-PERSON
  GLENDALE CITY HALL – COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  613 E. BROADWAY, GLENDALE, CA 91206

  DAN BROTMAN  VICTOR GORDO  NIKKI PEREZ
  Director  Chair  Vice Chair

Except as otherwise provided by law, no action shall be taken on any item not appearing on the agenda. When
addressing the Burbank Glendale Pasadena Regional Housing Trust (Trust), please state your name (or
pseudonym) for the record prior to providing your comments. In compliance with the Americans with
Disabilities Act, those requiring accommodation or services of an interpreter for this meeting should notify the
Interim Trust Manager 72 hours prior to the meeting at aeliason@civichome.net. Requests received less than 72
hours in advance will still receive every effort to reasonably fulfill within the time provided.

This agenda contains a brief general description of each item to be considered. The Burbank Glendale Pasadena
Regional Housing Trust encourages public participation. Members of the public may address the Trust
regarding any item in the following ways:
  1. In-person: If you wish to speak during public comment, please complete a Speaker Request Form and
  provide that form to the Clerk. Speaker Forms are located on the table next to the entrance doors.
  2. Written Comment – The Trust is also accepting public comments to be submitted by emailing them to
  aeliason@civichome.net. The comments will be distributed to all the Directors and read into the record.
  If you wish to comment on a specific agenda item, please identify the item in your email. General public
  comments will be addressed during the general public comment item on the agenda. In order to ensure
  that staff has the ability to provide comments to the Directors in a timely manner, please submit your
  comments prior to noon the day before the meeting. Public comments will be made available to the
  public upon request.
  3. Phone: If you wish to speak during any public comment portion of the meeting, you may call the
  following phone number: 818-238-3335.
  All supporting documentation is available for public review online at:
  https://www.bgphousingtrust.org/ and posted at Glendale City Hall located at
  613 E. Broadway, Glendale, CA 91206 during regular business hours,
  8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday.
  A GENDA –B URBANK – G LENDALE – P ASADENA – R EGIONAL H OUSING T RUST , S EPTEMBER 27, 2023 - P AGE 1
 CALL TO ORDER / ROLL CALL

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
At this time members of the public may address the Trust and emails received by the deadline will be read into
record on any matter not on the agenda but within the jurisdiction of the Trust. The Trust or Chair may limit
the length of time each individual may have to address the Trust, and emails received are to be read.

CONSENT CALENDAR ITEMS:

  1. Approve Burbank Glendale Pasadena Regional Housing Trust minutes from the July 12, 2023, meeting.

ACTION ITEMS:
At this time, members of the public in attendance may ask the Board to be heard, and emails received by members
of the public will be read into the record on the following items as those items are called.

  2. Approve Resolution for the Trust Conflict of Interest Code
  3. Authorize Execution of Banking Resolution, Certificate of Incumbency, Assignment Assumption and
  Consent Agreement, and Signature Card Transferring the Name of the Bank of America Account from
  the City of Glendale to the Trust
  4. Authorize Execution of Professional Services Agreement between Vasquez & Company LLP and the
  Trust for accounting services in an amount not to exceed $25,000.
  5. Authorize Execution of Professional Services Agreement with Burke, Williams & Sorensen for legal
  services in an amount not to exceed $25,000.
  6. Approve the Trust Project/Program Funding Policy

INTERIM TRUST MANAGER REPORT:

  7. Oral Report from the Interim Trust Manager

DIRECTOR COMMENTS:

ADJOURNMENT: Next Meeting November 1, 2023 (Pasadena City Hall)

  A GENDA –B URBANK – G LENDALE – P ASADENA – R EGIONAL H OUSING T RUST , S EPTEMBER 27, 2023 - P AGE 2
